options.content: ### 🔵 Consideration queue — awaiting the promoter  ·  `severity:med/high · triage:med · approved` minus `ready-for-implementer`
### 🟠 Self-change hold — awaiting architect ratification  ·  `label:compositional-self-change`  ·  platform repo only (app repos never self-modify — ADR-0019/0023)
### ⬛ Low / Nit — deferred by severity, drained on adjacency / active-cycle sweep  ·  `severity:low,severity:nit` (excludes `ready-for-implementer`)  ·  ADR-0037
### ⚠️ Untriaged / off-loop — no labels, invisible to the loop  ·  `is:open is:issue no:label` (not on the workflow diagram)
### 🟣 In flight — promoted & dispatched  ·  `label:ready-for-implementer`  ·  being built / reviewed / awaiting merge
### 📦 dep-watch digest — weekly dependency digest (read-only info sink)  ·  `label:dep-watch`  ·  normally exactly 1/repo
